title: The affected products insufficiently restrict runtime-supplied visualization commands, allowing local functionality on…
description: This vulnerability involves insufficient restriction of runtime-supplied visualization commands in certain products. It allows local functionality on the engineering workstation to be invoked if a user is logged into a CODESYS Control runtime and operates a visualization. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this by controlling a malicious runtime or performing a man-in-the-middle attack, potentially leading to arbitrary code execution on the engineering workstation.
